# Policy Change Monitor

> Watch terms of service or privacy policies and report exactly what changed.

- Actor: data_foundry/policy-change-monitor
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/policy-change-monitor
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: Compliance / monitoring
- Pricing: $2.00 per 1,000 pages checked; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: policy URLs (HTML or PDF)
- Output: line-level diff, similarity score, replaced and beyond-window flags
- Run: apify call data_foundry/policy-change-monitor
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~policy-change-monitor/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
